_comment: PROPOSED replacement for .claude/settings.json — review, then copy over it. Claude is blocked from editing settings itself (Self-Modification guard), which is correct: an agent should not rewrite its own permission boundary. Rationale per key is in .claude/settings.proposed.md.

hooks.description: ESLint --fix on edited TS/TSX. Replaces two prettier hooks that invoked an uninstalled package and matched only .tsx/.jsx.
hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac

hooks.description: Advisory only (always exit 0): flag uncommitted source changes at turn end so the gate is not skipped.
hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if ! git diff --quiet -- lib app 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Uncommitted changes under lib/ or app/ — run scripts/validate.sh before calling it done.'; fi; exit 0
